title: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Terms: Service Recovery Discount on Renewal After Rollover
content:
**Clause.** A service recovery discount is taken off the Commercial Natural Gas Supply offer price, on a renewal accepted after rollover, for businesses Beacon Ridge has had to correct:

(a) when two or more rebill credit lines were posted on the agreement later than the same calendar day twenty-four months before the acceptance date, the discount is $0.0100 per therm;

(b) when exactly one was, it is $0.0050 per therm;

(c) when none was, there is no service recovery discount.

The discount is a per-therm amount taken off the offer price once. The rebill credit lines are counted from the agreement's own bill lines.

## Counting window (hypothetical acceptance date 2026-01-10)

| Rebill credit lines posted on the agreement | Lines counted | Discount per therm |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-12-29 and 2024-06-14 | 2 | $0.0100 |
| 2025-12-29 only | 1 | $0.0050 |
| 2025-12-29 and 2024-01-10 | 1 (2024-01-10 is not later than the cut-off day) | $0.0050 |
| None since 2024-01-10 | 0 | None |
